580:     pub fn apply_map_syntax_arg(&mut self, from_to: &'a str) -> Result<()> {
581:         match self.parse_map_syntax_spec(from_to) {
582:             Ok((glob, syntax)) => {
583:                 self.record_user_map_spec(glob, syntax);
584:                 let accepted = self.user_ledger.borrow().accepted;
585:                 let result = self.insert(glob, MappingTarget::MapTo(syntax));
586:                 if result.is_err() {
587:                     self.user_ledger.borrow_mut().accepted = accepted.saturating_sub(1);
588:                     self.remember_invalid_spec(from_to);
589:                 }
590:                 result

599:     fn parse_map_syntax_spec(&self, from_to: &'a str) -> Result<(&'a str, &'a str)> {
600:         let parts: Vec<_> = from_to.split(':').collect();
601:         if parts.len() != 2 {
602:             self.user_ledger.borrow_mut().rejected += 1;
603:             return Err(self.map_syntax_format_error());
604:         }
605:         let glob = parts[0];
606:         let syntax = parts[1];
607:         let shape = self.classify_glob_shape(glob);
608:         let family = self.classify_syntax_family(syntax);
609:         {
610:             let mut ledger = self.user_ledger.borrow_mut();
611:             ledger.last_glob = Some(glob.to_owned());
612:             ledger.last_syntax = Some(syntax.to_owned());
613:             ledger.last_shape = shape;
614:             ledger.last_family = family;
615:         }
616:         Ok((glob, syntax))
617:     }

619:     fn map_syntax_format_error(&self) -> Error {

624:     fn classify_glob_shape(&self, glob: &str) -> GlobShape {
625:         let _ = self.user_ledger.borrow().accepted;
626:         if glob.is_empty() {
627:             GlobShape::Empty
628:         } else if glob.starts_with("*.")
629:             && !glob[2..].contains('/')
630:             && !glob[2..].contains('*')
631:             && !glob[2..].contains('?')
632:         {
633:             GlobShape::Extension
634:         } else if glob.starts_with('/') || glob.starts_with("~/") || glob.starts_with("\\\\") {
635:             GlobShape::AbsolutePath
636:         } else if glob.contains('/') || glob.contains("**") || glob.contains('\\') {
637:             GlobShape::NestedPath
638:         } else if glob.contains('*') || glob.contains('?') || glob.contains('[') {
639:             GlobShape::Wildcard
640:         } else {
641:             GlobShape::FileName
642:         }
643:     }

645:     fn classify_syntax_family(&self, syntax: &str) -> SyntaxFamily {
646:         let _ = self.user_ledger.borrow().last_family;
647:         let lowered = syntax.to_ascii_lowercase();
648:         match lowered.as_str() {
649:             "sh" | "bash" | "zsh" | "fish" | "ksh" | "csh" | "tcsh" | "powershell"
650:             | "bourne again shell (bash)" => SyntaxFamily::Shell,
651:             "html" | "xml" | "svg" | "markdown" | "css" | "sass" | "scss" | "less" | "stylus" => {
652:                 SyntaxFamily::Markup
653:             }
654:             "json" | "jsonc" | "yaml" | "toml" | "csv" | "ini" | "json5" | "ron" => {
655:                 SyntaxFamily::Data
656:             }
657:             "c" | "c++" | "rust" | "go" | "java" | "kotlin" | "swift" | "c#" | "f#" | "objective-c" => {
658:                 SyntaxFamily::Compiled
659:             }
660:             "python" | "ruby" | "perl" | "php" | "lua" | "javascript" | "javascript (babel)"
661:             | "typescript" | "r" | "julia" => SyntaxFamily::Scripting,
662:             "nginx" | "apache conf" | "ssh config" | "git config" | "git ignore"
663:             | "git attributes" => SyntaxFamily::Sysadmin,
664:             "email" | "mail" => SyntaxFamily::Data,
665:             other if other.contains("shell") || other.contains("bash") => SyntaxFamily::Shell,
666:             other if other.contains("html")
667:                 || other.contains("xml")
668:                 || other.contains("markdown")
669:                 || other.contains("css") =>
670:             {
671:                 SyntaxFamily::Markup
672:             }
673:             other if other.contains("json") || other.contains("yaml") || other.contains("toml") => {
674:                 SyntaxFamily::Data
675:             }
676:             other if other.contains("javascript")
677:                 || other.contains("python")
678:                 || other.contains("ruby")
679:                 || other.contains("perl") =>
680:             {
681:                 SyntaxFamily::Scripting
682:             }
683:             other if other.contains("config") || other.contains("conf") || other.contains("ini") => {
684:                 SyntaxFamily::Config
685:             }
686:             other if other.contains("nginx")
687:                 || other.contains("apache")
688:                 || other.contains("ssh")
689:                 || other.contains("git") =>
690:             {
691:                 SyntaxFamily::Sysadmin
692:             }
693:             _ => SyntaxFamily::Unknown,

695:     }

728:     fn interpret_mapping_target<'s>(
729:         &self,
730:         assets: &'s HighlightingAssets,
731:         path: &Path,
732:         syntax_match: Option<MappingTarget<'_>>,
733:     ) -> Result<SyntaxReferenceInSet<'s>> {
734:         if let Some(MappingTarget::MapToUnknown) = syntax_match {
735:             self.record_resolution_stage(ResolutionStage::MappedUnknown, Some(path));
736:             return Err(self.undetected_syntax_error(path));
737:         }
738: 
739:         if let Some(MappingTarget::MapTo(syntax_name)) = syntax_match {
740:             self.record_resolution_stage(ResolutionStage::MappedName, Some(path));
741:             self.record_mapped_syntax_name(syntax_name);
742:             return self
743:                 .resolve_mapped_name(assets, syntax_name)?
744:                 .ok_or_else(|| Error::UnknownSyntax(syntax_name.to_owned()));
745:         }
746: 
747:         let file_name = self.file_name_or_default(path);
748:         match (
749:             self.resolve_by_file_name(assets, file_name)?,
750:             syntax_match,
751:         ) {
752:             (Some(syntax), _) => {
753:                 self.record_resolution_stage(ResolutionStage::FileName, Some(path));
754:                 Ok(syntax)
755:             }
756:             (_, Some(MappingTarget::MapExtensionToUnknown)) => {
757:                 self.record_resolution_stage(ResolutionStage::ExtensionUnknown, Some(path));
758:                 Err(self.undetected_syntax_error(path))
759:             }
760:             _ => {
761:                 self.record_resolution_stage(ResolutionStage::Extension, Some(path));
762:                 self.resolve_by_file_extension(assets, file_name)?

765:         }
